Subject: An Update on Your Brewlog Pre-Order

Dear Brewer,

Thank you. 640 of you trusted us with a pre-order, and we don't take that lightly.

So here's the honest news: our Bluetooth certification hit delays, and shipping now starts March 17 instead of March 3. I know you want to get brewing. I'm sorry we're making you wait two more weeks.

The team is heads-down finishing the product, and we won't ship anything we're not proud of.

If the wait changes your mind, reply to this email and I'll refund you in full. No questions asked.

Cheers to great beer,
Niamh Doyle
Founder, Brewlog

Subject: Halftone Is Now in Lightroom

Hi there,

As a former wedding photographer, I know the struggle: endless hours culling thousands of images when you'd rather be shooting or editing. That's why I built Halftone.

Today, February 2, I'm happy to announce that Halftone is available as a Lightroom Classic plugin. Our AI flags blinks, blur, and near-duplicates right inside your existing workflow.

In our testing, Halftone culled 3,000 photos in 6 minutes on an M2 MacBook Air.

Try it free for 7 days, then it's $15/month.

Here's to getting your life back.

Leo Martins
Founder, Halftone

Subject: Faster month-end close for Halberd

Hi Priya,

I found Halberd Logistics while researching NetSuite users and saw you made the switch last year. Nice move.

I also noticed you're hiring 2 accounts payable clerks. When a finance team scales that fast, month-end tends to mean spreadsheets and late nights.

Ledgerline fixes that. Our AI matches bank and card transactions to NetSuite automatically, so you close faster and spend the saved days on real analysis. Our 38 customers have cut their close from 9 days to 4 on average.

Worth a 20-minute call next week to see if Halberd could get similar results?

Best,
Erik Lund
Founder, Ledgerline

Your hustle deserves to be paid on time. Create your first invoice today.

Co-founder, Kopa

Each kit comes with 4 advanced vibration sensors and a smart gateway. Your own technician installs it in under 2 hours. No PLC changes. No disruption. No headaches.

We build the kit in Pune, for Indian manufacturers. It costs ₹1,20,000, plus ₹6,000 per machine per month for the dashboard.

Request your kit today.

Regards,
Aditi Kulkarni
CEO, Ferrous

That's where Quietroom comes in. Our soundproof phone booths reduce noise by 32 dB, assemble in 45 minutes, and start at $6,400, so they're a flexible investment for your new office.

Here's what I noticed: you're selling through Instagram DMs. It works while orders are manageable, but it breaks down when they aren't, and that's where we come in.

That's where we come in. Fernway Studio builds Shopify stores for East African brands. Fixed price, KES 450,000, live in 6 weeks. We've launched 31 stores so far, 2 of them for skincare brands like yours.

Wanjiru Kamau
Founder, Fernway Studio

I've been following Kestrel & Finch's growth, and I saw you're hiring a project manager. Congratulations on the expansion.

That's where Tabwise comes in. It pulls data from Google Calendar and Jira and fills in timesheets automatically, so nobody has to do manual entry. Across 22 agencies, teams have recovered an average of 3.2 billable hours per person, per week. At your size, that adds up quickly.

Would you be open to a 15-minute chat to see if it fits how you work?

Co-founder, Tabwise

Subject: Hello, Kraków. Pokoik's Next Chapter Begins

Cześć,

We're happy to share that Pokoik is expanding to Kraków.

Starting November 20, you'll be able to book from 35 handpicked apartments in the historic neighborhoods of Kazimierz and Podgórze. With its cobblestone streets, café culture and creative energy, Kraków is a great backdrop for your next adventure.

As always, you'll enjoy flexible stays of 1–6 months and one simple, all-inclusive price, with high-speed internet included.

Your Kraków story starts here: pokoik.pl/krakow

Subject: Cutting Tillfin's synthesis time from weeks to minutes

Hi Marcus,

I watched your talk at ResearchOps Summit, and your point about synthesis taking "about three weeks per study" stuck with me. It's a challenge many research leaders face, and it rarely gets addressed.

That's why I'm reaching out. Fieldnote is an AI-powered research platform built for teams like yours that work with interview data. We transcribe interviews in 30 languages automatically, group quotes into themes, and let you export everything to Notion or Miro.

Imagine getting those three weeks back and spending the time on strategic, high-impact work instead.

I'd be glad to process one of your interviews for free so you can see how it works. Would you be open to it?

Best,
Hana Lee

Subject: Your post on CI times

Hi Dmitri,

I read "Why our CI takes 40 minutes" this morning. The part about a third of your reruns coming from flaky tests stuck with me. Most teams live with that, few write it down.

That's the problem we built Patchwork CI to fix. The platform detects and quarantines flaky tests in GitHub Actions automatically, so your engineers stop babysitting reruns. It runs on 1,200 repositories today.

I'd like to run it free on one of your repos and send you what we find. No strings attached.

Would that be of interest?

Cheers,
Tomas

1,000 families.

14 months ago, Pebble Pantry was an idea I scribbled down on maternity leave. Sleep-deprived, staring at an empty fridge at 7pm, no plan for dinner.

Today, 1,000 families pay €4.99 a month so that moment goes a little easier.

We never ran a fancy ad campaign or a growth hack. Most families found us in school WhatsApp groups. Parents telling other parents.

That's trust, and you can't buy it.

So to every mum and dad who shared us in a group chat: thank you. You built this with us.

And if you're a founder scraping by on a shoestring: keep going. Your community is your superpower.

#Startups #Portugal #Parenting #FemaleFounders #Gratitude

Losing our first big customer was the best thing that ever happened to Ledgerline.

Let me explain.

5 months in, they walked away. It stung. A lot.

But failure isn't the opposite of success. It's part of it.

The reason? They had heavily customized their NetSuite instance, and we only supported standard fields. We weren't meeting them where they were.

So we did what great teams do: we listened. We learned. We built.

We spent 6 weeks adding support for custom fields. That changed how we think about our customers, not just our feature list.

Today, we serve 38 customers. 11 of them rely on custom fields.

The lesson? Your biggest setback can become your biggest breakthrough.

Lean into the hard feedback. Your customers are telling you what to build. You just have to listen.

What's a loss that shaped your company?

#Startups #SaaS #Leadership #CustomerSuccess #Growth

Why we stopped billing by the hour, and never looked back.

When we started Fernway Studio, we did what every agency does: we charged hourly.

The result? 4 of our first 6 projects went over budget.

Clients were frustrated. We were frustrated. Trust was eroding.

So in 2024, we made a bold decision. We switched to a fixed price: KES 450,000 per Shopify store. Period.

And it changed everything.

Clients know exactly what they're paying. We're incentivized to work smarter, not longer. Relationships are built on trust, not timesheets.

Since then, we've launched 31 stores. Only 2 went over our 6-week timeline.

Pricing isn't just a number. It's a promise.

Founders, how do you price your services? Let me know in the comments!

#Entrepreneurship #Africa #Shopify #AgencyLife #Pricing

After 11 years in a clinic, I walked away. Here's why.

I've always loved being a vet, but something kept breaking my heart.

Day after day, I'd see anxious pets so terrified that we had to sedate them just to examine them.

I knew there had to be a better way.

So in 2023, I took the leap and founded Doorstep Vet.

The idea was simple: bring compassionate, high-quality care to pets in the one place they feel safest, their own home.

Today, our team of 4 vets does around 30 home visits a week. Every single one reminds me why we do this.

Calmer pets. Happier owners. Better medicine.

Sometimes the bravest thing you can do is follow your heart.

#Veterinary #PetCare #Melbourne #Entrepreneurship #FollowYourPassion

We built an app we were proud of. Nobody used it.

When we launched Rotaship, the mobile app was sleek and modern. We figured restaurant staff would love it.

Reality check: only 12% of staff opened it in the first month.

That stung. Then it taught us something: we weren't solving the real problem. We were adding another one.

Restaurant teams don't want another app. They live on WhatsApp.

So in 2025 we made the call. We moved everything into WhatsApp.

What happened next:
- 140 outlets
- Median reply time to shift messages: under 20 minutes

Meet your users where they already are. Don't make them come to you.

Sometimes the best product decision is letting go of the thing you love.

#ProductManagement #Indonesia #StartupLessons #UserExperience

1,200 repositories.

When we launched Patchwork CI, we made you a promise: always free for open source. People told us we were crazy. "How will you make money?" they asked.

Today, 1,200 repositories run on us, and about 900 are open source.

Now the part that stopped me cold.

Across all those repos, 1 in 7 CI failures turned out to be a flaky test. One in seven, so think about your last red build. Countless hours of developer time go to failures that were never real.

Open source gave us more than users. It gave us data, feedback, and a community. Our most-requested feature, GitLab support, came straight from OSS maintainers. We shipped it on November 12.

Giving back isn't charity. It's strategy.

#OpenSource #DevOps #CI #DeveloperExperience #BuildInPublic

We're hiring.

Big news: Quietroom is looking for its first Account Executive, and maybe that's you.

Here's the context. We've sold 210 booths so far, every single one by a founder. That got us here. It won't get us to the next stage. So we're hiring someone to own sales.

You'd fit if you're a driven sales professional who does well in a fast-paced startup, and who'd rather build relationships than burn through a call sheet.

What we're offering:
- £55,000 base plus commission
- London, 3 days a week in our office
- A real say in the future of workplace focus

If that sounds like your next job, apply through the link in the comments.

#Hiring #SalesJobs #London #StartupJobs #JoinOurTeam

We raised our prices 50%. Here's what happened.

In September, we made one of the scariest calls in Tabwise's history: $8 to $12 per user per month.

Why? Our support costs per customer had doubled since launch. So we had a choice. Cut quality, or charge what we're worth.

We charged what we're worth.

But we weren't about to punish loyal customers. Every existing customer kept their $8 price for 12 months.

The result?

Two out of 140 customers churned in the next 2 months.

The lesson: your customers aren't paying for software. They're paying for outcomes. Price accordingly.

Founders, when did you last raise your prices?

#SaaS #Pricing #StartupLessons #Growth #B2B

3 days. That's how long one spindle failure shut down our line.

Years ago, I worked as a maintenance engineer at an auto-parts plant in Pune. One day a spindle failed, and an entire production line sat idle for 3 long days.

Here's the part that still bothers me: the warning signs were there. 2 weeks earlier, vibration readings had clearly shown the problem. Nobody was watching.

That moment changed everything for me. In 2022, I founded Ferrous with one mission: to make sure no manufacturer has to go through that kind of preventable downtime again.

Today, our sensors are on 410 machines across 17 plants.

Every reading is a story. Every alert is a breakdown avoided. Every plant is a step closer to the future of Indian manufacturing.

Data only matters if someone is listening.

#Manufacturing #Industry40 #PredictiveMaintenance #MakeInIndia #StartupStory

Hardware is hard. Here's our story.

Our very first production run at Shelfwise didn't go as planned.

400 labels shipped with a faulty battery contact.

As a young hardware startup, it would have been easy to cut corners. But that's not who we are.

We made the call to recall and replace every single one of those 400 labels, at our own cost. It set us back about $7,000. Painful? Absolutely. Worth it? 100%.

Because trust is everything.

We didn't stop there. We introduced a 100% contact test at the factory. And since then? Zero contact failures across 6,000 labels.

Mistakes don't define you. How you respond to them does.

To all the hardware founders out there: own your mistakes, fix them fast, and build systems so they never happen again.

#Hardware #Startups #Manufacturing #Leadership #Integrity

$50K MRR. Bootstrapped. 18 months.

When I started Crateful, people told me I needed VC funding to succeed. That I'd never compete without a big team. That bootstrapping was "too slow."

Well, here we are.

$50,000 in monthly recurring revenue. Zero outside funding. A small team of 3.

Our secret weapon? The Shopify App Store. About 60% of our signups come from there. Never underestimate the value of being where your customers are already looking.

To every bootstrapped founder grinding late at night: your path is valid. Profitability beats hype, and sustainability beats vanity metrics.

What's one thing that helped you grow without funding? Drop it below.

#Bootstrapped #SaaS #Shopify #IndieHackers #FounderJourney

Our average fee was about $41,000 per hire. For an early-stage startup, that's a massive chunk of runway. And our incentives weren't aligned. Higher salary means a bigger fee. Is that really partnership?

So in January, we made a bold move: a flat $18,000 per hire. No percentages. No games.

The result? We've placed 26 senior Rust engineers this year, and our client relationships have never been stronger.

The recruiting industry needs to evolve. Founders deserve better.

Would you work with a flat-fee recruiter? Let me know.

#Recruiting #Startups #RustLang #Hiring #FutureOfWork

Just 2 years ago, we installed our very first system. Since then, we've helped 100 small businesses across São Paulo switch to clean energy, every single one with R$ 0 upfront.

Remote work isn't about where you work. It's about how you work together.
